metadata.title: Mid-Century Mod Beat Group Album Cover

retrievalProfile.description: A high-contrast 1960s album aesthetic featuring a saturated yellow header block with bold, colorful slab-serif typography above a group portrait of four men in mod fashion.
triggerTerms: saturated yellow header with bold slab serif

recipe.visualDefinition: A split-composition layout where the top third is a solid, vibrant yellow field containing three tiers of centered text in contrasting purple and red, while the bottom two-thirds features a medium-shot photograph of four men sitting closely together against a dark, textured background.
coreVisualRelationships: Vibrant yellow header vs. dark photographic base
Bold purple slab-serif vs. bright red sans-serif
Four-person group portrait as the primary visual anchor
Horizontal text alignment across the top third
coreInvariants: Saturated yellow background for the top text block
Heavyweight slab-serif display type for the primary title
Group portrait of subjects in 1960s mod attire

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Four subjects occupy the lower two-thirds of the frame, shown from the waist up in a tight, overlapping formation.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The large, purple slab-serif text at the top center acts as the primary anchor.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Eyes start at the bold purple title, move down to the red subtitle, scan the tracklist, and finally rest on the group portrait.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Minimal; the composition is densely packed with text and figures.

colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High saturation in the header area contrasts with the muted, earthy tones of the photography below.
paletteRestrictions: Must include primary yellow, purple, and red in the top section.

letterConstructionRules: Display type features thick, blocky slabs and high stroke contrast.
Secondary type is a clean, all-caps geometric sans-serif.
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: High-contrast pairing of a decorative, heavy slab-serif with a functional, clean sans-serif.

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the heavy slab-serif structure and vintage feel.
Appropriate for the bold, secondary sans-serif text.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a photo of four men in 1960s mod clothing (turtlenecks, pea coats, patterned shirts) sitting together in a group portrait. The top third of the image should be a solid, flat, saturated yellow rectangle.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add bold, purple slab-serif text centered in the top yellow block. Below it, add bright red all-caps sans-serif text. Include a small tracklist in red sans-serif with bullets between items.

verificationChecks: Is the top third a solid yellow block?
Is the main title a heavy purple slab-serif?
Is the secondary text bright red and all-caps?

adjustableVariables: Number of subjects in the portrait
postGenerationChecks: Check that the yellow header is a flat color without texture.
Ensure the purple text is the largest element in the composition.
Verify the subjects' hairstyles match the mid-60s aesthetic.
Confirm the red text is legible against the yellow background.
recipe.reuseFormula: Yellow Header + Purple Slab-Serif + Red Sans-Serif + Mod Group Portrait = 1960s Beat Album
